verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה רְאֵ֛ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְפַרְעֹ֑ה וְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֖יךָ יִהְיֶ֥ה נְבִיאֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh rə·’êh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·p̄ar·‘ōh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā yih·yeh nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD . . . answered Moses See I have made you like God to Pharaoh and your brother Aaron will be your prophet
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO disse o SENHOR a Moisés: Eis que te tenho posto por deus sobre Faraó, e Arão, teu irmão, será o teu profeta.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תְדַבֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ וְאַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֙יךָ֙ יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯə·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·we·kā wə·’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā yə·ḏab·bêr ’el- par·‘ōh wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: You are to speak all that I command you and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites . . . go out of his land
verses.literalPt: Tu falarás tudo o que eu te mandar; e Arão, teu irmão, falará a Faraó, que deixe ir os filhos de Israel da sua terra.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י אַקְשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י אֶת־ אֹתֹתַ֛י וְאֶת־ מוֹפְתַ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’aq·šeh ’eṯ- lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ō·ṯō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- mō·wp̄·ṯay bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart and though I will multiply My signs and wonders in the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, endurecerei o coração de Faraó, e multiplicarei na terra do Egito os meus sinais e as minhas maravilhas.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֲלֵכֶם֙ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ יָדִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוֹצֵאתִ֨י אֶת־ צִבְאֹתַ֜י אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בִּשְׁפָטִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiš·ma‘ ’ă·lê·ḵem par·‘ōh wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî bə·miṣ·rā·yim wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯay ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim biš·p̄ā·ṭîm gə·ḏō·lîm
verses.literal: Pharaoh will not listen to you Then I will lay My hand on Egypt and by mighty acts of judgment I will bring the divisions of My people the Israelites . . . out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Faraó, pois, não vos ouvirá; e eu porei minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirarei meus exércitos, meu povo, os filhos de Israel, da terra do Egito, com grandes juízos.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֤וּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּנְטֹתִ֥י אֶת־ יָדִ֖י עַל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוֹצֵאתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִתּוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū miṣ·ra·yim kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bin·ṭō·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘al- miṣ·rā·yim wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mit·tō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I stretch out My hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites . . . out from among them
verses.literalPt: Então os egípcios saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando estender a minha mão sobre o Egito, e tirar os filhos de Israel do meio deles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹתָ֖ם כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām kên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded them
verses.literalPt: Assim fizeram Moisés e Arão; como o SENHOR lhes ordenara, assim fizeram.

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁה֙ בֶּן־ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַֽהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּדַבְּרָ֖ם אֶל־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh ben- šə·mō·nîm šā·nāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ben- šā·lōš ū·šə·mō·nîm šā·nāh bə·ḏab·bə·rām ’el- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: Moses was eighty years old . . . and Aaron . . . was eighty-three . . . . . . when they spoke to Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: E Moisés era da idade de oitenta anos, e Arão da idade de oitenta e três anos quando falaram a Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: The LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵכֶ֤ם פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם מוֹפֵ֑ת וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֧ח אֶֽת־ מַטְּךָ֛ וְהַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי־ פַרְעֹ֖ה יְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·ḵem par·‘ōh lê·mōr tə·nū lā·ḵem mō·w·p̄êṯ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭə·ḵā wə·haš·lêḵ lip̄·nê- p̄ar·‘ōh yə·hî lə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: When Pharaoh tells you . . . Perform a miracle you are to say . . . to Aaron Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh and it will become a serpent
verses.literalPt: Quando Faraó vos falar, dizendo: Fazei vós um milagre, dirás a Arão: Toma a tua vara, e lança-a diante de Faraó; e se tornará em serpente.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַשׂוּ כֵ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ מַטֵּ֗הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’el- par·‘ōh way·ya·ʿa·śū ḵên ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh way·yaš·lêḵ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭê·hū lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh wə·lip̄·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·hî lə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did . . . just as the LORD had commanded Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh . . . and his officials and it became a serpent
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés e Arão foram a Faraó, e fizeram assim como o SENHOR ordenara; e lançou Arão a sua vara diante de Faraó, e diante dos seus servos, e tornou-se em serpente.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא֙ גַּם־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה לַֽחֲכָמִ֖ים וְלַֽמְכַשְּׁפִ֑ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֨וּ גַם־ הֵ֜ם חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā gam- par·‘ōh la·ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·lam·ḵaš·šə·p̄îm way·ya·‘ă·śū ḡam- hêm ḥar·ṭum·mê miṣ·ra·yim bə·la·hă·ṭê·hem kên
verses.literal: But Pharaoh called the wise men and sorcerers and magicians of Egypt and they also did the same things by their magic arts
verses.literalPt: E Faraó também chamou os sábios e encantadores; e os magos do Egito fizeram também o mesmo com os seus encantamentos.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁלִ֙יכוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַטֵּ֔הוּ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְתַנִּינִ֑ם וַיִּבְלַ֥ע מַטֵּֽה־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶת־ מַטֹּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·lî·ḵū ’îš maṭ·ṭê·hū way·yih·yū lə·ṯan·nî·nim way·yiḇ·la‘ maṭ·ṭêh- ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: Each one threw down his staff and it became a serpent But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs
verses.literalPt: Porque cada um lançou sua vara, e tornaram-se em serpentes; mas a vara de Arão tragou as varas deles.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַק֙ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not listen to them just as the LORD had said
verses.literalPt: Porém o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os ouviu, como o SENHOR tinha falado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כָּבֵ֖ד לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה מֵאֵ֖ן לְשַׁלַּ֥ח הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh kā·ḇêḏ lêḇ par·‘ōh mê·’ên lə·šal·laḥ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding he refuses to let the people go
verses.literalPt: Então disse o SENHOR a Moisés: O coração de Faraó está endurecido, recusa deixar ir o povo.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֞ה בַּבֹּ֗קֶר הִנֵּה֙ יֹצֵ֣א הַמַּ֔יְמָה וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִקְרָאת֖וֹ עַל־ שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֑ר וְהַמַּטֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְנָחָ֖שׁ תִּקַּ֥ח בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ ’el- par·‘ōh bab·bō·qer hin·nêh yō·ṣê ham·may·māh wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā liq·rā·ṯōw ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr wə·ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer- neh·paḵ lə·nā·ḥāš tiq·qaḥ bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake
verses.literalPt: Vai pela manhã a Faraó; eis que ele sairá às águas; põe-te em frente dele na beira do rio, e tomarás em tua mão a vara que se tornou em cobra.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעִבְרִים֙ שְׁלָחַ֤נִי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְיַֽעַבְדֻ֖נִי בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְהִנֵּ֥ה לֹא־ שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַד־ כֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr šal·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî bam·miḏ·bār wə·hin·nêh lō- šā·ma‘·tā ‘aḏ- kōh
verses.literal: Then say to him The LORD the God of the Hebrews has sent me . . . to tell you Let My people go so that they may worship Me in the wilderness But until now you have not listened
verses.literalPt: E lhe dirás: O SENHOR Deus dos hebreus me tem enviado a ti, dizendo: Deixa ir o meu povo, para que me sirva no deserto; porém eis que até agora não tens ouvido.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּזֹ֣את תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַכֶּ֣ה׀ בַּמַּטֶּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָדִ֗י עַל־ הַמַּ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיְאֹ֖ר וְנֶהֶפְכ֥וּ לְדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh bə·zōṯ tê·ḏa‘ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mak·keh bam·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer- bə·yā·ḏî ‘al- ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer bay·’ōr wə·ne·hep̄·ḵū lə·ḏām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says By this you will know that I am the LORD Behold with the staff in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile . . . and it will turn to blood
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Nisto saberás que eu sou o SENHOR: Eis que eu com esta vara, que tenho em minha mão, ferirei as águas que estão no rio, e tornar-se-ão em sangue.

verses.original: וְהַדָּגָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֛ר תָּמ֖וּת וּבָאַ֣שׁ הַיְאֹ֑ר וְנִלְא֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן־ הַיְאֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·ḡāh ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr tā·mūṯ ū·ḇā·’aš hay·’ōr wə·nil·’ū miṣ·ra·yim liš·tō·wṯ ma·yim min- hay·’ōr
verses.literal: The fish in the Nile will die the river will stink and the Egyptians will be unable to drink its water
verses.literalPt: E os peixes, que estão no rio, morrerão, e o rio cheirará mal; e os egípcios terão nojo de beber da água do rio.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֡ן קַ֣ח מַטְּךָ֣ וּנְטֵֽה־ יָדְךָ֩ עַל־ מֵימֵ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם עַֽל־ נַהֲרֹתָ֣ם׀ עַל־ יְאֹרֵיהֶ֣ם וְעַל־ אַגְמֵיהֶ֗ם וְעַ֛ל כָּל־ מִקְוֵ֥ה מֵימֵיהֶ֖ם וְיִֽהְיוּ־ דָ֑ם וְהָ֤יָה דָם֙ בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבָעֵצִ֖ים וּבָאֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ maṭ·ṭə·ḵā ū·nə·ṭêh- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- mê·mê miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- na·hă·rō·ṯām ‘al- yə·’ō·rê·hem wə·‘al- ’aḡ·mê·hem wə·‘al kāl- miq·wêh mê·mê·hem wə·yih·yū- ḏām wə·hā·yāh ḏām bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇā·‘ê·ṣîm ū·ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses Tell . . . Aaron Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt over their rivers . . . and canals . . . and ponds and all the reservoirs that they may become blood There will be blood throughout the land of Egypt even in the vessels of wood and stone
verses.literalPt: Disse mais o SENHOR a Moisés: Dize a Arão: Toma tua vara, e estende a tua mão sobre as águas do Egito, sobre as suas correntes, sobre os seus rios, e sobre os seus tanques, e sobre todo o ajuntamento das suas águas, para que se tornem em sangue; e haja sangue em toda a terra do Egito, assim nos vasos de madeira como nos de pedra.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֤רֶם בַּמַּטֶּה֙ וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּיְאֹ֔ר לְעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיֵּהָֽפְכ֛וּ כָּל־ הַמַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֖ר לְדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh way·yā·rem bam·maṭ·ṭeh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer bay·’ōr lə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·lə·‘ê·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yê·hā·p̄ə·ḵū kāl- ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr lə·ḏām
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron did . . . just as the LORD had commanded in the presence of Pharaoh . . . and his officials Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile and all the water - was turned to blood
verses.literalPt: E Moisés e Arão fizeram assim como o SENHOR tinha mandado; e Arão levantou a vara, e feriu as águas que estavam no rio, diante dos olhos de Faraó, e diante dos olhos de seus servos; e todas as águas do rio se tornaram em sangue,

verses.original: וְהַדָּגָ֨ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֥ר מֵ֙תָה֙ וַיִּבְאַ֣שׁ הַיְאֹ֔ר וְלֹא־ יָכְל֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם מִן־ הַיְאֹ֑ר וַיְהִ֥י הַדָּ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·ḡāh ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr mê·ṯāh way·yiḇ·’aš hay·’ōr wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū miṣ·ra·yim liš·tō·wṯ ma·yim min- hay·’ōr way·hî had·dām bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The fish in the Nile died and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E os peixes, que estavam no rio, morreram, e o rio cheirou mal, e os egípcios não podiam beber a água do rio; e houve sangue por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֛ן חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּלָטֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק לֵב־ פַּרְעֹה֙ וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên ḥar·ṭum·mê miṣ·ra·yim bə·lā·ṭê·hem way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq lêḇ- par·‘ōh wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the magicians of Egypt did the same things by their magic arts So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron just as the LORD had said
verses.literalPt: Porém os magos do Egito também fizeram o mesmo com os seus encantamentos; de modo que o coração de Faraó se endureceu, e não os ouviu, como o SENHOR tinha dito.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣פֶן פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥ת לִבּ֖וֹ גַּם־ לָזֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en par·‘ōh way·yā·ḇō ’el- bê·ṯōw wə·lō- šāṯ lib·bōw gam- lā·zōṯ
verses.literal: Instead, Pharaoh turned around went into his palace and did not take any of this to heart
verses.literalPt: E virou-se Faraó, e foi para sua casa; nem ainda nisto pôs seu coração.

verses.original: וַיַּחְפְּר֧וּ כָל־ מִצְרַ֛יִם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הַיְאֹ֖ר מַ֣יִם לִשְׁתּ֑וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לִשְׁתֹּ֔ת מִמֵּימֵ֖י הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·pə·rū ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim sə·ḇî·ḇōṯ hay·’ōr ma·yim liš·tō·wṯ kî lō yā·ḵə·lū liš·tōṯ mim·mê·mê hay·’ōr
verses.literal: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink because they could not drink the water from the river
verses.literalPt: E todos os egípcios cavaram poços junto ao rio, para beberem água; porquanto não podiam beber da água do rio.

verses.original: וַיִּמָּלֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים אַחֲרֵ֥י הַכּוֹת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הַיְאֹֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·lê šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ’a·ḥă·rê hak·kō·wṯ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- hay·’ōr
verses.literal: And seven full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile
verses.literalPt: Assim se cumpriram sete dias, depois que o SENHOR ferira o rio.
